label: GO after a rewarded common a1 trial, strongly committed to a1, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass). It needs the previous trial to be rewarded (never fires when prev_reward is 0), the previous choice to be a1 or out of the window (never after a2), and the previous transition to be common (never after rare). It fires only when the agent then picks a1 (the policy logit a1-a2 is in its top decile, >8.07) and only in the first ~50 trials of an episode (most mass in trials 10-29, none after 60). So it is an a1-specific stay-after-common-reward signal at GO. Predicate uses only observed variables and the agent own policy output; the profile on the future action is the same as on choice. Dev: recall ~1.0, mass recall ~1.0, but precision only ~0.28 (F1 0.44); adding a value band, a tighter choice threshold or a reward-2-back condition did not raise precision above ~0.32, so the conditions are necessary but not sufficient. Magnitude (from example windows, not systematically checked): largest on the first rewarded a1 GO after an unrewarded trial, then decays over consecutive rewarded a1 trials (about 1.0, 0.83, 0.55, 0.32, 0.12). Weaker at the window rel +1 GO. Never active at D1 or D2, after a2, after rare transitions, or late in the episode.
